## v13.2.0

Updates the fork to upstream 3x-ui v3.10.2 plus the subsequent Xray and dependency updates, preserving reseller accounts, quotas, multipliers and Telegram sales features.

- Preserve existing reseller quotas when an edit omits the quota field; reject invalid limits.
- Correct multiplier accounting for local and remote clients, prevent repeated snapshot billing and counter overflow, and avoid compounding reused traffic deltas.
- Restore AmneziaWG and other new protocol settings in reseller inbound pickers.
- Keep manually disabled resellers' clients disconnected during edits and usage resets; clean up client attachments and runtime settings during reseller deletion.
- Make Telegram sales bots globally disabled by default. The main admin can enable them under Settings → Telegram; saved owner configurations are preserved.
- Improve the added menus on phones, including card views for reseller management.
- Bundle matching installation, update and service scripts with Linux packages, verify release payloads, and publish stable only after all builds succeed.

Assets include Linux amd64, Linux arm64 and Windows amd64 packages with SHA-256 checksums. Tagged binaries report version 13.2.0.

Before updating a running installation, retain a matching database and installation backup. The Windows panel executable is named `3x-ui.exe`. This release requires explicit opt-in to resume Telegram sales bots.
